# subscription-stripe

> Generated by `scripts/docs-generate.ts` from `modules/subscription-stripe/registry-item.json` and its skill. Do not edit this file. Run `pnpm docs:generate` to update it.

## Environment variables

| Variable | Services | Optional | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | api | no | Your Stripe secret key (sk_test_… while you develop, sk_live_… in production). Required once SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=stripe. The client is built on first use, so a project that keeps SUBSCRIPTION_PROVIDER=console runs the whole capability — sign-in included — with this unset; the throw then names the key on the first call that reaches Stripe. |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | api | no | The signing secret of the endpoint you registered at https://dashboard.stripe.com/webhooks, pointing at https://<your-api>/auth/stripe/webhook. The plugin verifies every delivery against it, so an unsigned POST is refused before any handler runs. |
